title: Scheduler supersession dispositions
description:
Objective: land the scheduler half of the graph supersession engine - the complete, deterministic, hash-bound attempt/effect/resource/budget disposition set for a supersession, composing the landed authority and budget primitives. Slice 2 of 2 from task-dddfaf83f9c644099b5b263e485c58c7, split by architect-d46fcb95 on human direction 2026-08-09 because the whole task needs 13 distinct files against a 10-file hard cap.

Hard dependency: task-6b8d0e2e948b48f7a1f40ad5a00a4a13 (Core revision supersession, epochs and carry binding) must land first - it owns the epoch, carry-binding and disposition-kind vocabulary this slice consumes. Do not restate or re-derive any of it here, and do not mint a second vocabulary.

MEASURED PRESENT at 2026-08-09 - every primitive this slice composes already exists, so nothing here needs a prerequisite:
- DRAIN is already built. packages/scheduler/src/authority/lease-drain.ts exports DrainDisposition (:31), DrainTerminalTarget (:29), parseDisposition (:118), applyDrainReason (:142) and releaseWork (:194). Compose it; do NOT reimplement drain.
- RESOURCE: packages/scheduler/src/authority/lease-resource.ts and resource-model.ts (SLOT_STATES, published from the scheduler root at index.ts:67,151), plus lease-fencing.ts and lease-state.ts. From task "Lease presence core", DONE.
- BUDGET: packages/scheduler/src/budget/{budget-account,budget-contract,budget-measurement,budget-reservation,budget-settlement}.ts, with budget-reservation published at index.ts:78,168.
- EFFECT/ATTEMPT vocabulary lives in @moe/contracts runtime-vocabulary.ts - the attempt lifecycle already carries SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED/SUPERSEDED/RELEASED/UNKNOWN. Compose it.

MEASURED ABSENT: packages/scheduler/src/supersession/ does not exist, and nothing in packages/scheduler/src consumes a supersession disposition today.

*** WARNING measured by the architect: packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts pins the EXACT root namespace with `expect(EXPECTED_EXPORTS.length).toBe(36)` (:57) and a `toEqual` deep-compare (:61). Any new root value export reddens it until transcribed by hand and the count literal bumped. Transcribe from your module source, never from the namespace under test. ***

REAL CONSUMER ALREADY WAITING (Clause 1): packages/scheduler/src/admission/admission-wait.ts:10 documents the handoff by name - "supersession carry of wait/blocker projections -> graph supersession engine". Wiring that carry is this slice's consumer edge.

Deliverable: packages/scheduler/src/supersession/supersession-dispositions.ts (+ .js bridge), its focused test, and curated publication from packages/scheduler/src/index.ts with index-surface.test.ts updated.

NOT in scope: the revision lifecycle, epochs or carry binding (slice 1); the graph.supersede transition (slice 1); rewriting history; implicit approval carry; daemon persistence; UI.

Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/supersession/**, packages/scheduler/src/index.ts, packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test
definitionOfDone: Every attempt, effect, resource and budget disposition produced for a supersession is COMPLETE over the declared kind set - a kind with no disposition is a refusal, never an omission - and a generated sweep asserts the case count is non-zero and equals the declared kind count.

Dispositions are deterministic and hash bound: the same inputs produce a byte-identical disposition set and digest, ordering is canonical rather than discovery-ordered, and the digest covers exactly the bound field list through one shared function.

The drain disposition composes packages/scheduler/src/authority/lease-drain.ts (parseDisposition/applyDrainReason/releaseWork) and the resource and budget dispositions compose lease-resource/resource-model and budget-reservation/budget-settlement; none of that authority is reimplemented in this module or in a test helper.

A changed or UNKNOWN authority, resource or budget fact refuses carry with an existing @moe/contracts code and the refusing layer rather than silently disposing; UNKNOWN never upgrades to a safe carry and partial dispositions never make a set complete.

The consumer edge is landed, not merely exported: the wait/blocker carry that packages/scheduler/src/admission/admission-wait.ts:10 defers to the supersession engine is wired to this surface with one durable call site.

The scheduler root publishes the surface by a curated named block with index-surface.test.ts's hand-written list and count literal updated, and fresh pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test exits 0 with every production file at or below 250 physical lines.
taskRails: Do not start until task-6b8d0e2e948b48f7a1f40ad5a00a4a13 has landed the epoch, carry-binding and disposition-kind vocabulary. Re-deriving it here forks the vocabulary and is exactly what the rails forbid.
Compose the landed drain, lease-resource, resource-model and budget primitives. A property must be asserted against the production surface, never against a test helper that reimplements it.
A dependency, readiness, fairness or semantic claim without verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused; an incomplete disposition set is a refusal, not a partial success.
Tests assert the exact stable reason code and the refusing layer, and any generated sweep asserts it produced a non-zero number of cases.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source, split before 400; this cap is per file, not per task.
